verdict: Both are about the same. Calories and protein are the same, only Maggi goreng has slightly more fat.
why: Both are an estimated 600 kcal per plate. In terms of energy, it's a draw.
Protein is also the same, an estimated 18 g each.
Maggi goreng has an estimated 27 g fat, mee goreng mamak 23 g. Instant noodles are already fried during production, then fried again.
Both are tasty and easy to finish fast, especially with a sweet drink. Portion control matters more than which noodle you choose.
when_a: Mee goreng mamak is okay for an occasional dinner at the mamak, especially if you add egg and vegetables.
when_b: Maggi goreng is okay when you really crave it. Enjoy one plate and balance it with lighter food at your other meals.
tip: Ask for less oil, add egg or chicken, and choose teh O ais kosong (unsweetened iced tea) or plain water.

faq.a: Mee goreng mamak usually has a bit less fat. But it depends a lot on the cook, so asking for less oil helps.

faq.q: If I eat this once a week, is that okay?
faq.a: Okay. What matters is your total calories for the week and getting enough protein and vegetables at your other meals.
